rationale: The first v3 retained attempt generated blockMesh successfully but the JobManager did not recognize the new multi-segment full-O-grid profile schema as direct blockMesh geometry and incorrectly invoked snappyHexMesh. V4 changes only fail-closed runtime command routing so the manifest-bound full-revolution path uses blockMesh plus checkMesh. It changes no geometry, physics, threshold, grid, identity algorithm, trend, product status, or promotion gate.

prospectiveRevision.runtimeCommandRoutingChange: recognize flowlab.full-ogrid-path-profile.v1 as a direct blockMesh topology only when its manifest has positive segment count, exactly five blocks per segment, 3D all-hex cells, zero collapsed-axis cells, and no boundary interfaces
